verdict.rationale: gstack is built from SKILL.md files (review, qa, ship and others), and CONTRIBUTING.md describes a dev mode that symlinks your checkout into .claude/skills/ so Claude Code reads skills straight from it. That gives a documented path for working on skills, but nothing shown documents a template or the name/description frontmatter contract, so a new author would still have to copy existing skills. Skillify and domain skills are agent-generated notes and scripts, not a developer authoring template. Missing for 10: a documented SKILL.md authoring template, a frontmatter (name/description) specification, a step-by-step new-skill guide, and hands-on corroboration.
